findings.issue: Unauthenticated GET /api/fixture/world invokes syncStops and can update computed UniStop ownership/arrivals
findings.impact: Unauthorized trigger of server-computed synchronization; not arbitrary SQL or client-selected balances
findings.fix: Require authenticated portal player or admin before synchronization
findings.state: Deployed to isolated Production release; post-deploy public checks PASS

findings.issue: Matchmaking allocates room/seat before instance-level WebSocket authentication
findings.impact: Anonymous resource allocation/DoS surface; does not grant authenticated gameplay mutation authority
findings.fix: Static authentication before allocation, revalidate on WS join, pass auth context in HTTP adapter, bound body, origin/method validation and safe HTTP error status
findings.state: Deployed to isolated Production release; post-deploy public checks PASS

findings.issue: PostgreSQL listens on all network addresses; UFW inactive and default input accepts
findings.mitigationPresent: pg_hba restricts incoming database login to loopback and Tailscale with password authentication; no proof of successful unauthorized DB connection
findings.state: Configuration finding only; no firewall or database changes
